column2: Most meteors burn up in the mesosphere, which is why shooting stars appear high above the clouds.
column3: 大多數流星在中氣層燃燒殆盡，所以流星會出現在雲層上方很高的地方。
column4: meteors in the mesosphere (中氣層中的流星)
column5: meso 中間 + sphere 球：位在大氣層中間那一層

column2: The space station orbits within the thermosphere, where temperatures can climb above a thousand degrees.
column3: 太空站在熱層中運行，那裡的溫度可升到超過一千度。
column5: thermo 熱（thermos 保溫瓶）+ sphere：熱呼呼的大氣層

column2: Deep below the volcano, magma slowly collects in a huge chamber before it erupts.
column3: 在火山深處，岩漿在一個巨大的腔室中緩慢聚集，然後才噴發。
column5: magma 像「馬格馬」：地下滾燙的馬路熱到融化

column2: Once magma reaches the surface and flows out of a volcano, it is called lava and cools into black rock.
column3: 岩漿一旦到達地表並從火山流出，就稱為熔岩，冷卻後變成黑色岩石。
column5: lava 像「拉瓦」：火山一噴，大家快「拉」跑「瓦」

column2: A glacier moves only a few centimeters a day, yet over centuries it can carve a deep valley.
column3: 冰河每天只移動幾公分，但歷經數世紀卻能刻出一條深谷。
column5: glacier 像「葛雷西爾」：冰河是「格外冷」的大冰塊

column2: Scientists study glaciation to learn how huge sheets of ice once covered much of North America.
column3: 科學家研究冰河作用，以了解巨大冰層曾經如何覆蓋北美大部分地區。
column5: glacier 冰河 + ation 過程：冰河形成與擴張的過程

column2: Heavy rain and strong wind caused serious erosion along the coast, carrying away tons of soil each year.
column3: 大雨與強風造成沿海嚴重侵蝕，每年帶走數噸泥土。
column5: e 出 + rode 啃咬：一口一口把土啃走

column2: Weathering breaks large cliffs into small pieces through frost, rain, and the slow growth of plant roots.
column3: 風化作用藉由霜凍、雨水和植物根部緩慢生長，把大型懸崖分解成小碎塊。
column5: weather 天氣 + ing：天氣日積月累把石頭弄碎

column2: A huge crater in the desert shows where a meteorite struck the Earth thousands of years ago.
column3: 沙漠裡一個巨大的隕石坑，顯示數千年前有一顆隕石撞擊地球。
column5: crater 像「克雷特」：像大碗，一個圓形大洞

column2: When the volcano's magma chamber emptied, the ground collapsed and formed a vast caldera ten kilometers wide.
column3: 火山的岩漿庫被掏空後，地面塌陷，形成一個寬十公里的巨大破火山口。
column5: caldera 像西班牙語「鍋」caldero：像一個大鍋子

column2: Ancient sailors used celestial bodies such as the sun, moon, and stars to find their way across the sea.
column3: 古代水手利用太陽、月亮和星星等天體在海上辨明方向。
column5: celestial 像「誰雷斯提歐」：誰在天上？是星星

column2: Earth, Mars, and Venus are terrestrial planets, meaning they have solid, rocky surfaces rather than gaseous ones.
column3: 地球、火星和金星是類地行星，意思是它們擁有固態岩石表面，而非氣態表面。
column5: terra 土地：站在泥土地上的，就是陸地的

column2: Some scientists believe that extraterrestrial life, if it exists, may be as simple as bacteria.
column3: 有些科學家相信，外星生命如果存在，可能只像細菌一樣簡單。
column5: extra 之外 + terrestrial 地球的：地球之外的
column7: ex - tra - ter - res - tri - al

column2: Researchers examined a meteorite found in Antarctica and discovered it was older than the Earth itself.
column3: 研究人員檢查了在南極洲發現的一顆隕石，發現它比地球本身還要古老。
column5: meteor 流星 + ite 石頭：掉到地上的流星石

column2: We stayed up late to watch a bright meteor streak across the night sky.
column3: 我們熬夜看一顆明亮的流星劃過夜空。
column5: meteor 像「米提歐」：米粒大的光點在夜空飛過

column2: An asteroid about the size of a city bus passed safely between the Earth and the moon last week.
column3: 上週一顆約有城市公車大小的小行星安全地從地球與月球之間飛過。
column5: aster 星 + oid 像：長得像星星的小石頭

column2: Halley's comet returns to the inner solar system roughly every seventy-six years, trailing a long, glowing tail.
column3: 哈雷彗星大約每七十六年回到內太陽系，拖著一條長長的發光尾巴。
column5: comet 像「康姆」：comb 梳子般的長長尾巴

column2: Orion is a winter constellation that people have recognized for thousands of years because of its three bright belt stars.
column3: 獵戶座是冬季星座，由於三顆明亮的腰帶星，人們已辨認它數千年。
column5: con 一起 + stella 星：星星聚在一起排成圖案

column2: The Moon takes about twenty-seven days to orbit the Earth, while the Earth itself orbits the sun.
column3: 月球環繞地球一圈約需二十七天，而地球本身則環繞太陽運行。
column5: orbit 像「歐必特」：哦，必須轉一圈

column2: Inside the nebula, clouds of gas and dust slowly collapse and form new stars.
column3: 在星雲內部，氣體與塵埃雲慢慢塌縮並形成新恆星。
column5: nebula 拉丁文「雲」：天上的一團氣體雲

column2: When a giant star runs out of fuel, it may collapse and explode as a supernova brighter than a whole galaxy.
column3: 當巨大恆星耗盡燃料，可能塌縮並爆發成亮過整個星系的超新星。
column5: super 超級 + nova 新星：一顆突然超亮的新星

column2: A pulsar spins hundreds of times per second, sending out a regular beam like a cosmic lighthouse.
column3: 脈衝星每秒旋轉數百次，像宇宙燈塔一樣發出規律光束。
column4: a rotating pulsar (旋轉的脈衝星)
column5: pulse 脈搏 + ar：像心跳一樣一下一下閃

column2: Astronomers believe each quasar is powered by a supermassive black hole at the center of a distant galaxy.
column3: 天文學家相信，每個類星體的能量都來自遙遠星系中心的超大質量黑洞。
column4: a distant quasar (遙遠的類星體)
column5: quasi 類似 + stellar 恆星：長得像恆星，其實超亮

column2: Nothing, not even light, can escape from a black hole once it crosses the boundary near the center.
column3: 一旦越過靠近中心的邊界，連光也無法從黑洞逃脫。
column4: supermassive black hole (超大質量黑洞)
column5: 黑洞像吸塵器，把光都吸進去，連光也逃不掉

column2: Our solar system sits inside the Milky Way, a galaxy containing hundreds of billions of stars.
column3: 我們的太陽系位於銀河系內，這個星系包含數千億顆恆星。
column5: galaxy 與 galaktos 牛奶有關：像灑出的一道牛奶河

column2: A powerful solar flare can disturb radio signals and even knock out power grids on Earth.
column3: 強大的太陽閃焰可能干擾無線電訊號，甚至使地球上的電網停擺。
column4: a solar flare erupts (太陽閃焰爆發)
column5: solar 太陽 + flare 閃光：太陽突然「閃」出一道光

column2: Galileo observed a dark sunspot moving across the sun and concluded that the sun rotates.
column3: 伽利略觀察到一個暗色太陽黑子橫過太陽表面，因此推斷太陽會自轉。
column4: a large sunspot (大型太陽黑子)
column5: sun 太陽 + spot 斑點：太陽臉上的小黑點

column2: During a total solar eclipse, the moon passes in front of the sun and turns day into twilight.
column3: 日全食期間，月球走到太陽前方，使白晝變得像黃昏。
column5: eclipse 像「一蹺立」：月亮一翹，把太陽擋住

column2: Astronomers estimate a star's distance by comparing its luminosity with how bright it appears from Earth.
column3: 天文學家比較恆星的光度與它在地球上看起來的亮度，來估算其距離。
column5: lumin 光（illuminate 照亮）+ osity：發光的程度

column2: Satellite images revealed the topography of the island, showing steep mountains in the north and flat plains in the south.
column3: 衛星影像顯示出島上的地形，北部是陡峭山脈，南部則是平坦平原。
column5: topo 地點 + graph 畫：把地方的高低畫成地圖

column2: Hawaii's islands are made mostly of basalt, a dark rock formed when lava cools quickly.
column3: 夏威夷群島主要由玄武岩構成，這種深色岩石是熔岩快速冷卻而成。
column5: basalt 像「白色鹽」顛倒：黑黑的火山岩，不是白鹽

column2: Kitchen counters made of granite resist scratches and heat, so many people choose them for their homes.
column3: 花崗岩廚房檯面耐刮又耐熱，所以許多人選它裝潢家裡。
column5: gran 顆粒 + ite 石：由一粒粒晶體組成的石頭

column2: Caves often form in limestone because rainwater slowly dissolves the soft rock over thousands of years.
column3: 洞穴常在石灰岩中形成，因為雨水經過數千年慢慢溶解這種軟岩。
column5: lime 石灰 + stone 石頭：由石灰質組成的石頭

column2: The old church was built of golden sandstone, a rock made of tiny grains pressed together over time.
column3: 這座古老教堂以金黃色砂岩建成，這種岩石由細小沙粒經長時間壓實而成。
column4: red sandstone cliffs (紅色砂岩懸崖)
column5: sand 沙 + stone 石：沙子壓成的石頭

column2: Fossils of fish were found in a thin layer of shale that once lay at the bottom of an ancient sea.
column3: 魚類化石出現在一層薄薄的頁岩中，這些頁岩曾位於古海海底。
column5: shale 像 shell：像貝殼一片片剝開的薄岩

column2: Geologists read the strata in the canyon wall like pages of a book, each layer marking a different age.
column3: 地質學家像讀書頁一樣讀取峽谷壁上的地層，每一層代表不同的年代。
column5: strata 是 stratum 的複數，像一層層「史塔塔」疊起來

column2: The stratification of the lake water, with warm water floating above cold, prevents oxygen from reaching the bottom.
column3: 湖水的成層現象使溫水浮在冷水上方，阻止氧氣到達湖底。
column5: strat 層 + ification 形成：一層一層分開的過程

column2: Paleontology uses fossils to reconstruct how ancient animals looked, lived, and changed over millions of years.
column3: 古生物學利用化石重建古代動物的外貌、生活方式及數百萬年的演變。
column5: paleo 古老 + ology 學問：研究古老生物的學問
column7: pa - le - on - tol - o - gy

column2: Annual precipitation in the rainforest exceeds three meters, mostly falling as heavy afternoon rain.
column3: 雨林的年降水量超過三公尺，多半是午後的大雨。
column5: pre 先 + cip 頭：水從雲頭往下掉成降水

column2: Farmers in the dry region pump water from a deep aquifer, but the underground supply is slowly shrinking.
column3: 乾燥地區的農民從深層含水層抽水，但地下水供應正慢慢減少。
column5: aqua 水 + fer 攜帶：帶著水的地層
